about: The mutant ledger of runtime/v1/sql: edits of std sql's host body that its own tests must kill. Run it with go run ./scripts/mutants ./runtime/v1/sql (docs/tooling.md, "Mutant ledger"). Seeded by wf10 STORES TX1.

mutants.name: sql-begin-ignores-the-stop
mutants.rule: stdlib.md, sql 2: a stop of the task that began a transaction rolls it back.

mutants.name: sql-rollback-panics-when-done
mutants.rule: stdlib.md, sql 2: Conn.Rollback never fails; a transaction that has ended is ErrTxDone, ignored.

mutants.name: sql-stamp-loses-nanos
mutants.rule: stdlib.md, sql 1: a Stamp reaches the driver as its time, to the nanosecond.

mutants.name: sql-error-drops-constraint
mutants.rule: stdlib.md, sql 5: a unique violation names its constraint.

mutants.name: sql-closed-not-read
mutants.rule: stdlib.md, sql 5: a statement on a pool, connection or transaction that has ended is Closed.
